comment: Suites for tests/isa/check.py. Each suite is one directory of riscv-tests/isa. check.py reads
the test names from that directory's Makefrag, compiles each test for the physical memory
environment (env/p) with the given -march, and runs it on the given VP.
`isa` is passed to the VP as --isa and sets the extensions misa reports.
`skip` lists tests that are not built: the VP does not implement what they test, or the
compiler cannot assemble them. `known_failures` lists tests that are built and run and are
expected to fail. A known failure that starts to pass is reported, so the

known_failures.rv32ui-p-ma_data: the VP traps on a misaligned load or store, which the specification allows; this test needs them to complete
known_failures.rv32mi-p-csr: test case 13: FLW, FSW, FLD and FSD do not check mstatus.FS, so an FP store with the FPU off writes memory instead of trapping
known_failures.rv32mi-p-instret_overflow: test case 2: a CSR write to minstret does not suppress the increment of the instruction that wrote it
known_failures.rv32mi-p-sbreak: EBREAK stops the direct runner with an exception instead of raising a breakpoint trap
known_failures.rv32si-p-sbreak: EBREAK stops the direct runner with an exception instead of raising a breakpoint trap
known_failures.rv32si-p-dirty: the VP crashes with a segmentation fault in CombinedMemoryInterface::store_word under Sv32 translation
known_failures.rv64ui-p-ma_data: the VP traps on a misaligned load or store, which the specification allows; this test needs them to complete
known_failures.rv64ui-p-srli: test case 2: rv64 SRLI casts rs1 to uint32_t before the shift, so the upper 32 bits are lost
known_failures.rv64uc-p-rvc: test case 12: C.SRLI expands to SRLI, see rv64ui-p-srli
known_failures.rv64mi-p-mcsr: test case 2: reads misa.MXL with SRLI, see rv64ui-p-srli
known_failures.rv64mi-p-breakpoint: test case 2: rv64 does not implement the trigger CSRs tselect and tdata1 to tdata3, which rv32 does, so accessing them traps
known_failures.rv64mi-p-csr: test case 13: FLW, FSW, FLD and FSD do not check mstatus.FS, so an FP store with the FPU off writes memory instead of trapping
known_failures.rv64mi-p-instret_overflow: test case 2: a CSR write to minstret does not suppress the increment of the instruction that wrote it
known_failures.rv64mi-p-sbreak: EBREAK stops the direct runner with an exception instead of raising a breakpoint trap
known_failures.rv64si-p-sbreak: EBREAK stops the direct runner with an exception instead of raising a breakpoint trap
known_failures.rv64si-p-dirty: the VP crashes with a segmentation fault in CombinedMemoryInterface::store_word under Sv39 translation
known_failures.rv64si-p-icache-alias: the VP crashes with a segmentation fault in CombinedMemoryInterface::load_instr under Sv39 translation
